loginDescription: Auth Package is enabled. Local users can access the web UI.
recoverDescription: Use one of your one-time recovery keys. After reset, sign in with the new password.
signInNewPassword: Sign in with the new password.
firstUserCreatedDetail: User {username} can now sign in and create other users.
bootstrapDetail: No users exist yet. Create the first local account once; public registration is disabled after this step.
settingsSubtitle: These settings protect the web UI and configuration API. Integration inbound endpoints keep their own endpoint auth.
enableEnforcementDetail: When off, OMH behaves as before.
protectApiDetail: Does not protect /api/bus/in/* and webhook endpoints.
changePasswordDetail: Weak passwords are allowed by product decision. Existing sessions are revoked after password change.
recoveryKeysDetail: They are shown once. Each key can reset the password one time and is invalidated after use.
localUsersDetail: Any enabled user can sign in and work with the full OMH web UI. Roles are intentionally not part of v1.
